in_marathi.name: Avyukt
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avyukt हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avyukt is a Sanskrit word that refers to something that is unmanifest, unseen, or invisible. It is often used in Hindu philosophy to describe the ultimate reality or Brahman, which is beyond the physical world and cannot be perceived through the senses.
